props.description: A Muleta echo. 【own attributes + 7】 Deal 【HR + 40】 Physical damage to one enemy; a creature hit Bleeds. Free.

props.description: A Warning Shot echo. 【own attributes + 9】 Overflow: every enemy hit becomes Shaken. No damage. Free.
props.name: Warning Shriek

props.description: A Stop echo. 【own attributes + 5】 Only an enemy that has not yet acted this round can be chosen; it loses its action this round (nothing carries over). Costs 10 HP of the fragment.
props.name: Stolen Hour

props.description: A Phantasm echo. 【own attributes + 5】 Deal 【HR + 45】 Dark damage to one enemy; a creature hit becomes Dazed. Free.
props.name: Mirror Wraith

props.description: The fragment lashes out. 【own attributes + 7】 Deal 【HR + 30】 Dark damage to one enemy. Free.
props.name: Soul Echo

props.description: A Barrage echo. 【own attributes + 6】 Multi 3: up to three different enemies, each takes 【HR + 20】 Physical damage. Free.
props.name: Phantom Volley

props.description: A Descabello echo. 【own attributes + 7】 Only an enemy in Crisis can be chosen. Deal 【HR + 60】 Physical damage with Crush. Costs 10 HP of the fragment.
props.name: Ghost Descabello

props.description: A Provoke echo. 【own attributes + 6】 Overflow: every enemy hit is Provoked toward the fragment through its next turn. Free.
props.name: Mocking Provoke

props.description: A Glacies echo. 【own attributes + 6】 Deal 【HR + 40】 Ice damage to up to two enemies. Each creature hit becomes Slow. Free.
props.name: Frozen Requiem

props.description: A Soul Steal echo. 【own attributes + 7】 One enemy hit loses 50 HP (HP loss, not damage); the fragment gains 50 HP. Free.
props.name: Soul Siphon

props.description: A Drain Spirit echo. 【own attributes + 8】 The target loses 【HR + 40】 Mind Points; the fragment recovers half of the MP lost as HP. Free.
props.name: Spirit Leech

props.name: Hollow Charm

props.description: A hunter's last shot, loosed in light. 【own attributes + 7】 Deal 【HR + 60】 Light damage to one enemy. Free.
props.name: Dawnbreak Arrow
Soul Fragment
props.study_text: A torn-off piece of someone's soul, called down into the dark. Destroy it and what it took goes home. Leave it, and it takes more.
